WITH country_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.birth_country,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM player_college pc
  INNER JOIN player p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.birth_country
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(record_count) as total_records,
    AVG(CAST(record_count AS FLOAT)) as avg_count
  FROM country_counts
),
with_shares_and_excess AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.birth_country,
    cc.record_count,
    t.total_records,
    t.avg_count,
    CAST(cc.record_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_records as share,
    cc.record_count - t.avg_count as excess
  FROM country_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
  WHERE cc.record_count > t.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  SUM(record_count) as total_record_count,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(excess) as average_excess
FROM with_shares_and_excess
